author: Roosman
quote: Graphics are great but the 15 fps makes me feel like I'm going crosseyed. Lucia is a girl boss and Jason's character is just shallow. The game is unpolished and has alot of glitches. I got stuck in the house wall in the first hour of gameplay. No auto save in 2026 is wild. The game doesn't deserve my $80 and doesnt deserve a good review. Could change my mind in the future if they decide to adjust things.
